title: Section — Agent Suggestions (proposed two-way sync)
description: The agent's reasoned conclusions and suggested changes, staged for a USER-APPROVED two-way sync back to the connected tools. Nothing writes outward without explicit approval in the dashboard GUI. Kinds: meetings to resolve items, schedule changes to protect the critical path, budget adjustments, change orders for scope that appears unbudgeted, constraint solutions, and alternative specs/products/suppliers. Tone is senior-PM: calm, specific, supportive — it explains circumstances so the team relaxes, never alarms.

rationale.description: Calm, specific senior-PM reasoning with the relevant facts.
